# Cloud Engineer

Read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) — it is the Layer 0 entry point and defines the two lanes, the folder map, and the non-negotiable rules.

This file exists only so GitHub Copilot auto-loads that pointer. The canonical content lives in `AGENTS.md`.

If `specify init --integration copilot` overwrites this file, re-run `scripts/bootstrap-speckit.sh`, which restores the pointer.
